data.evaluation_source: Public, reviewed words.hk dictionary examples mirrored in AlienKevin/wordshk-tools/examples/wordshk.csv
data.evaluation_license: Hong Kong Lexicography Limited; Non-Commercial Open Data License1.0; evaluation-only, not bundled in app or used for training.
data.selection: Source/family hash order before decoding; headword/duplicate/one-edit families kept in one split; one example per group. Known target substrings6+ excluded. New dictionary examples are evaluation-only.
data.limits: Human-authored dictionary usage examples, not contemporary private chat, observed typing frequency or a speaker-disjoint live-device trial. Internal commas omitted only to form a continuous Han composition. Original glyphs retained.

training.feature_support_unit: Distinct corpus conversation, Tatoeba translation-family or project-authored template; rival/checkpoint/slot variants never multiply independent support.

training.purpose: Search survival only; actual baseline pruning margins; no words.hk dictionary examples in training; no full-sentence features.

final_calibration.validation_role: Calibration after the first policy outcomes; independent800 remains unopened.

exposure_audit.scope: Raw HKCanCor training chunks, licensed Tatoeba training chunks and current baseline vocabulary. No outcome-based exclusions. Dictionary examples may contain previously known short words.

verification.final_license_list_compile: Passed javac against cached Android35 SDK, generated R.jar and app classes; no APK packaging.

limitations: One top-five gain and no first-choice gain on800 public dictionary examples; small evidence, not population accuracy.
